title: Standing order: {goods} for the {workshop}
The larder runs low
summary: The {workshop} of {settlement} keeps a standing order for {goods}: {count} × {item}.
offer: Folk eat every day, and the {workshop} has little to give them. {count} × {item}, please, and come back when you have more.
I will take {count} × {item} today and the same again next week.
complete: That will fill the hooks a while.
